layout.note: All 99 sources are placed once, in order: 49 output rows, 48 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. Piece lengths run 36 code points at the median, inside the manual-v1 range. 2 inserted spaces across 1 original row boundary are decided separately above, each accepted as the minimal correction where a boundary cut a sentence. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre, and every item against the corpus-wide statistics.
